style: Avant-garde art-pop, trashy cabaret punk, and microtonal post-punk. Sléndro-informed five-step pitch field with bitonal modal drone, microtonal beating, and quartal suspension. Angular cabaret patter with lexical tone contours, glottalized vowel leaps, and hocketed syllables. 3:2 coupling pulse with asymmetric motorik subdivision, clap/footfall body percussion, and competing entrainment clocks. Fluorescent ballast hum, shift-register noise, magnetic tape loops, 8-bit pulse synth, cristal baschet, thunder sheet, large sheet metal, and spring reverb tank as instrument. Leader plus distorted echo group with Akan-influenced L1 phonological transfer, obsessive glottal stops, and lexical tone × phonation coupling. Trashy cheap spectacle performed straight under panic-under-function pressure. Dry close-miked studio recording with local spring reverb washes, tape loops, metal impacts, and abrupt dynamic cuts. Extended dynamic range with frequency modulation and oscillation.
